findings.text: the landed record cites git diff --stat for its "1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)" figure, but that command prints nothing at the clean reviewed tree and git show --stat 2d451dbd reads 3 files, 34 insertions and 1 deletion, so only the scoped form (git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD -- docs/AGENTS.md) yields the quoted line and a reader reproducing the citation as written gets no output.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the repository document describes the restart policy the unit generators carry; docs/AGENTS.md:106-107 now names Restart=always with the five-second delay and RestartSec=5, and the value it names is the value I re-rendered myself through reckon/service.py render_unit(), which returns Restart=always and RestartSec=5.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate and the resolved 16-line reading with per-file counts, the positive control at base and at HEAD, plan metas unchanged and a clean worktree — all of which I reproduced, and grep confirms plan-version 47 and plan-impl 0.733 are identical at base and HEAD.

justifications.fit: the new bullet keeps the file's bold-claim-then-guidance idiom at docs/AGENTS.md:106-108, takes its value from the generator it describes, and the commit message carries no plan identifier, ticket reference or AI attribution.
